body.x: Monster Sound, a creator of a new product category that revolutionized the audio market, unveiled "SuperStar Speaker" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Monster's SuperStar Speaker delivers sound wirelessly without losing the detail and power.
